evidence_boundary: All existing 2024-2025 outcomes are already exposed; new retrospective rounds cannot be fresh validation. Each selection must be written before its exposed scoring. No post-exposed parameter search.
interpretation_correction: Meta-labeling and disagreement abstention remain unresolved, not disproven. Filings are untested without timestamps. A lower market hit frequency is a candidate explanation for calibration drift, not a demonstrated causal decomposition.

sector_placebo.assignment: Permute issuer sector labels within each date, preserving exact group sizes, reuse assignment consistently across every sector-conditioned component. No outcomes enter the permutation.
sector_placebo.primary_comparison: Frozen annual champion rescored after recomputing all sector-conditioned input percentiles, component score percentiles and high/SIP overlays. Evaluate on the SAME original true-sector outcome queries; shuffling evaluation groups is a separately labelled composition diagnostic.
sector_placebo.control: Unshuffled full champion replay must match saved active scores within 1e-10. Otherwise no full-champion placebo conclusion; identify partial component results explicitly.
sector_placebo.pass: Development true-sector IC exceeds the 95th percentile shuffled IC by at least 0.01013492400721767; true-minus-shuffled date-block lower 95% bound >0. Exposed direction positive under the same locked protocol. Pair accuracy, global cross-section and Top3 attainment secondary. A tie does not prove a newly trained sector-free model is equivalent.

prospective_ledger.retention: Append-only data-only Git branch; no force pushes or record replacement; each manifest links the previous manifest hash. Same record slot is idempotent. New policy/model revision requires a new stream identifier.
prospective_ledger.daily_local_time: 19:30 Asia/Kolkata, including weekends for announcement capture
prospective_ledger.initial_stream: Frozen complete champion at the existing dated runtime inputs, recorded with actual observation and source-as-of dates. Stale inputs do not become a fresh current-date forecast merely by being recorded today.
prospective_ledger.eligibility: Only date-aligned scores issued before the forward outcome window and before outcomes are known can count for the 12-month holdout. No backfilled run is prospective. Component-only streams cannot stand in for the complete champion.
prospective_ledger.hysteresis: Initial stream margin0.02 with explicit model/profile/sector state, immediate invalidation for known corporate-action, suspension and data-quality flags; missing event coverage is marked unknown, never reported as a clean bill of health.
prospective_ledger.events: Archive exchange-provided timestamp strings and actual first-observed UTC times separately; preserve source HTTP/status, hashes, coverage and acquisition failures. No invented filing timestamps or PDF parsing. No automated orders or messages.
prospective_ledger.hurdle_limits: These are historical selection-noise hurdles for a specified family, not universal significance cutoffs or absolute-IC null thresholds. Evaluate paired incumbent/challenger differences and recompute temporal uncertainty on the prospective cohort.
prospective_ledger.earliest_review: 12 months after the first eligible genuinely prospective forecast; preserve missing days and failed acquisitions. Never relabel stale/bootstrap records as eligible later.

other_workstreams: Separate preregistrations cover daily hysteresis, historical NIFTY500 and goal scenarios/risk. Revisit meta-labeling and disagreement only if the PIT work supplies enough mature observations.
